live.title: This isn’t a PowerPoint. It’s a web app.
live.body: Every slide you just saw is a page in this app. Every number below is counted from the app itself, right now.

controls.title: Go on, change it
controls.body: Pick a colour, a slide design or a transition. The whole app changes, not just this slide.
controls.phone: Open the guide on your phone

prompt.title: One prompt can build this app
prompt.body: The stack, the content, every section, presenter mode, the diagrams, the themes and the accessibility rules, written down as a single prompt. Here it is: scroll to read it, or copy it and try it yourself.
prompt.label: The prompt

thanks.title: Thank you for your patience
thanks.body: Pick one habit and try it this week. The guide will be here whenever you need it.
